plan: To preserve capital, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to zero.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5% monthly return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower drawdown. Expect reduced volatility but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to align with concentration limits.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5% monthly growth, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while maintaining some exposure to quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and drawdown compared to aggressive modes.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to comply with concentration limits.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by stretching into leverage and concentration. It carries significantly higher risk, including larger potential drawdowns and daily decay from leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage these amplified risks.
